description:
Mirrors GitHub issue theodoreOnzGit/kopitiam#67. Unverified report (no repro file attached yet): a LaTeX-produced dissertation PDF still shows solid blue/black advance-box glyph fallback on kopitiam-pdf 0.2.6 (the release that closed #31).

Hypotheses from the issue, roughly by likelihood for a LaTeX dissertation:
1. Composite/CID-keyed OpenType-CFF fonts (CIDFontType0C) -- common with XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX + OpenType text/math fonts. This routing predates #31 and is untouched by it, so if broken, it's a separate pre-existing gap, not a regression.
2. seac-composed accented glyphs in glyph_type1.rs's Type1 interpreter -- my new code from #31, plausible edge case.
3. Predefined Expert/ExpertSubset CFF encoding -- documented, accepted ceiling from #31 (glyph_cff.rs:39-40). Unlikely for LaTeX but not ruled out.

Needs a reproduction (the dissertation PDF or a trimmed excerpt) plus which LaTeX engine/font setup produced it before a real diagnosis is possible.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content: Cross-engine graceful fallback landed on main (176c52b, mandatory, no feature gate): rasterize_page now re-renders with hayro whenever kopitiam's own DrawDevice hit the advance-box fallback for at least one glyph on a page, covering all three hypotheses above (CID-keyed CFF, seac, predefined-Expert encoding) without needing to diagnose which one applies -- hayro is a separate, independently-maintained PDF interpreter so it isn't subject to the same ceilings. Still needs verification against the actual repro (no dissertation PDF/excerpt attached yet) before this can be closed as fixed; if hayro also can't parse the page, kopitiam's box-fallback output is kept as-is (never worse than 0.2.6).

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
2026-08-28: maintainer confirms the arXiv PDF renders correctly, so the boxes are document-specific, not universal — consistent with this bead's CID-keyed-CFF / seac / Expert-encoding hypotheses rather than a broad regression.

kpdf-doctor (3b94137) now removes this bead's blocker. It has been stuck since 2026-08-25 on 'needs a reproduction'; the dissertation may not be shareable, but the doctor's output is. Run:

    ./target/release/kpdf-doctor thesis.pdf --pages 1-5

Its FONT lines print BaseFont, /Subtype plus the descendant CIDFont's, which /FontFile* is embedded with its own /Subtype, and whether the font yields outlines or falls back to advance boxes. That set distinguishes all three hypotheses directly: CIDFontType0C shows as embed=FontFile3:CIDFontType0C, a seac failure shows as a Type1 font that loads but yields no outlines, Expert encoding shows on a Type1C.

Control run on the 78-page arXiv fixture: 345 font instances, all 'ok (Type1 program)', 0 boxed — the tool reports success, it does not merely fail to find fault.

notes.author: root@vm
notes.content:
2026-08-28 — HYPOTHESES SUPERSEDED. See bd-veq / gh-94.

kpdf-doctor on a maintainer-supplied form workbook found the actual mechanism, and it is none of this bead's three hypotheses. All 51 boxed font instances are NON-EMBEDDED (ArialMT, Arial-BoldMT, Arial-ItalicMT, TimesNewRomanPSMT; /Subtype /TrueType, no /FontFile*). All 29 embedded fonts render fine.

So the boxes are not a decode failure of an embedded program (CID-keyed CFF / seac / Expert encoding) — there is nothing to decode. kopitiam-pdf has no standard-14 / descriptor-based substitution path (PDF 32000-1:2008 s9.6.2.2, s9.8.2).

This bead's own LaTeX-dissertation repro is still unconfirmed and may yet be a genuinely different, embedded-program case — keep it open for that. But non-embedded substitution is now the first thing to rule out on any new box report, and it is by far the more common cause (Word/LibreOffice output). Run kpdf-doctor and read the embed= column before assuming a decoder bug.

title: kopitiam-pdf 0.2.6: blue/black glyph-fallback boxes still appear on a LaTeX dissertation PDF (follow-up to #31)
